# Kerr Electrical Services

> Your local, experienced electrician in Lenzie, Kirkintilloch and Glasgow. Family-run, over 35 years of experience, free quotes. Reliable, high-quality electrical work for homes and businesses across Glasgow, East Dunbartonshire, North Lanarkshire and Falkirk. Call or text 07469 042726.

## Key facts

- Business name: Kerr Electrical Services (KES)
- Electrician: Eddie, time-served, over 35 years' experience
- Trade: Electrician, domestic (and some commercial) work
- Based: Lenzie / Kirkintilloch, East Dunbartonshire, Scotland

- Services: sockets and switches; Ring doorbell and Hive thermostat installation; internal lighting; electrical testing and safety checks; outdoor lighting; fault finding and repairs; full and partial rewires; general domestic electrical work
